assertions.text: The answer does not post `@dependabot close` and says it is deprecated
The answer re-reads the PR's live state and asks via AskUserQuestion (close only / close and stop future updates / skip)
For close only it runs the script's `close` action on 109 (a dry run for the question, then the real run), not a raw gh pr close, with no marker handshake
The answer refuses to delete the branch and to add a close comment because the script cannot express either
The answer re-reads state afterwards and records the PR as closed, and mentions that GitHub's docs do not say a manual close stops future proposals so an ignore command is the way
